cases.rationale: The crop shows cooked vegetables in dark sauce, with distinct broccoli florets and orange carrot batons. The green beans, baby corn and other vegetable pieces do not identify any other listed food. The surrounding black curved vessel could be a cooking pan/wok or a deep serving bowl; its profile and any handle are outside the crop, leaving bowl unclear. No utensil or dining-table context is identifiable. All 75 definitions were considered against the whole crop.

The straw overhead and leafy background do not show an umbrella frame, potted plant or another category object. All 75 definitions were considered; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The cylindrical drink object behind it is a beverage can, without a bottle neck or cup opening. The narrow work surface by the window has no identifiable dining-table context, and no chair structure is visible. All 75 definitions were considered; there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

The reddish upholstered seating behind the foreground person is only partly visible, so I cannot determine whether it is another individual chair or part of a couch; couch remains unclear. Wall pictures and screen contents are representations, not actual category objects. The right-hand counters and equipment cabinets do not establish a dining table or kitchen appliance. All 75 definitions were considered.
